$comment: Phase 24 (0.2.4) package-documentation-and-compatibility-truth scope gate and evidence record. Machine-readable source of truth for plans/024-Release-0-2-4-Package-Documentation-And-Compatibility-Truth.md: the seven 0.2.4 implementation items (primitive review; umbrella wording truth; generated package truth; peer-version policy Decision A; structural docs truth; built/packed truth conformance; docs finalization + bump + exit gate) each with task ownership and evidence tokens, the compat policy (version-literal-only at 0.2.4 — reviewed plain gate deltas: pre-bump gate at 0.2.3 zero deltas; post-bump gate at 0.2.4 the version literal alone on @arnilo/prism; baselines regenerated with --update-baseline, no --allow-break), the protected-gate policy (unchanged from phase23: required surfaces with absent evidence record blocked and fail the release gate; the 33 protected/live skips stay named), per-task evidence tokens, and the deviation log. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json. Baseline evidence for the exit gate lives in scripts/phase24-baseline.json (green: true, blocked: false, captured 2026-08-15 at the 0.2.4 working-tree state with PRISM_TEST_POSTGRES_URL set).

deviations.change: Closure correction 31 -> 43 during Task 2: the Task 0 hand-walk under-expanded non-provider direct deps (missed prism-code -> base/coding-agent/coding-security/mcp and prism-sdk -> credentials-node/observability-opentelemetry/workflows plus compaction/tool-validator and the 2 compaction strategies), recording closure 31 / 18 unreachable.
deviations.rationale: The manifest-derived generator proved prism-all closure 43 / omits exactly 5 — the roadmap's five notable omissions ARE the complete omission set. All Task 1 wording, the evidence doc, and the plan were corrected to 43; the evidence doc carries a CORRECTION note.

deviations.change: Docs version literals stayed at 0.2.3 (the actual current version) through Tasks 2-5; Task 6's scripted bump advanced them to 0.2.4 in one pass.
deviations.rationale: Docs never claim an unshipped version (plan 023 precedent: literals advance at the bump task); the ratified 0.2.4 end state is preserved by Task 6.
Docs tests and the phase24 leg read the artifact directly; the in-gate equality test (artifact == fresh generator run) provides tamper detection.

deviations.change: phase24-truth.test.mjs is wired into the npm test gate segment (after phase23-quality-gates), not security:threat-suites.
deviations.rationale: The plan allowed either; the gate segment runs on every npm test and the truth leg needs no protected env.

deviations.change: Peer-consistency test reads all workspace manifests itself (expandWorkspaceDirs + readManifest, exported from the generator) instead of deriving names from the artifact; session-store-codecs is exempt from the file:../.. devDep assert (42 of 43).
deviations.rationale: The artifact has no name-to-path mapping; exporting readManifest is a generator-module change only, not an artifact-shape change.

deviations.change: The ERESOLVE assert matches npm's quoted peer output: '@arnilo/prism@"0.2.5"' (quotes between @ and version).
deviations.rationale: npm prints the conflicting peer quoted; the bare substring is absent from the error text.

deviations.change: 12 workspace skeleton tests keep hardcoded peer pins at the 0.2.4 literal (repo convention, matching packaging/release tests).
deviations.rationale: They are deliberate pins of the exact-peer policy per package; deriving would duplicate root-manifest reads across 12 files. Further action: consider a shared derived constant.
